english_html:
📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇：The First Day of a New Journey Today marks the beginning of a 30-day memory adventure. As I open my worn-out vocabulary book, the words seem to dance before my eyes. Each term carries a unique meaning, like keys unlocking doors to a broader world. I recall the advice of my mentor: 'Consistency is the bridge between ambition and achievement.' With a steady heart, I plan to memorize twenty words daily, reviewing them at dawn and dusk. Though the path is long, I believe that every small effort accumulates into great progress. This journey is not merely about exams; it is a test of my perseverance and passion for learning. 中文翻译：今天标志着30天记忆冒险的开始。当我翻开那本破旧的词汇书，单词似乎在眼前舞动。每个词都承载着独特的意义，如同钥匙打开通往更广阔世界的大门。我记起导师的建议：“坚持是雄心与成就之间的桥梁。”怀着坚定的心，我计划每天记忆二十个单词，在黎明和黄昏时复习。虽然路途漫长，但我相信每一点小小的努力都会汇聚成巨大的进步。这段旅程不仅仅关乎考试；它是对我毅力和学习热情的一次考验。 重点词汇：adventure (冒险), worn-out (破旧的), unique (独特的), unlock (开启), ambition (雄心), achievement (成就), steady (坚定的), memorize (记忆), accumulate (积累), perseverance (毅力)。
✅ 每日自测
中译英：1. 今天标志着30天记忆冒险的开始。2. 每个词都承载着独特的意义。3. 坚持是雄心与成就之间的桥梁。 英译中：1. The words seem to dance before my eyes. 2. I plan to memorize twenty words daily. 3. Every small effort accumulates into great progress. 句子填空：1. Today ______ the beginning of a 30-day memory adventure. (答案：marks) 2. Consistency is the ______ between ambition and achievement. (答案：bridge)
